text: The following steps describe how to upload the ipem.xml file: 1. Create an Item with ltem ID = Pro2_XML. The initial ltem Revision is automatically created by Teamcenter. The ltem may be revised any number of times, as settings change, and the integration will always find and retrieve the file from the latest available revision. 2. Under the ltem Revision, create a dataset named Pro2_XML (remove the /{RevisionID} extension from the dataset name) oftype Creo Integration Settings. 3. Import the ipem.xml file as a named reference ofthe dataset. 4. Advise users to restart their sessions, to use the managed copy of ipem.xml. 人 \ 目 田 画 一 v 口 Pro2 XML 国 pro2_XML v 助 pro2 XMUA1 图 proz_ XMUA & Pro2 XML & View
